strata_definition: rank-tie-broken quartiles Q1 (lowest) through Q4 (highest), frozen before aggregation
uncertainty_method: independent Poisson delta method; audit labels fixed for reporting; no null resampling
interpretation: Descriptive cross-split closure with propagated counting uncertainty and a prefix assigned-event breakdown. The audit split contains retrospective public labels; this is not a background-only negative-control closure, and it does not propagate detector/systematic uncertainty, look-elsewhere effects, or downstream physics-fit cost.
